security.csp: default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Local-first disk analyzer and duplicate cleaner
bundle.longDescription: CleanMyFiles explains disk usage, verifies exact duplicates, surfaces large and old files, and moves selected items to the system Trash or Recycle Bin.
